settings.title: Session Recordings
settings.description: Records remote sessions and stores the videos in an S3 compatible bucket (Amazon S3, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, MinIO...). The copy on this server is deleted as soon as the upload is confirmed.
settings.boto3Missing: The boto3 library is not installed on the server: /rmm/api/env/bin/pip install boto3
settings.meshSetup: To record MeshCentral sessions, run once on the server (in /rmm/api/tacticalrmm with the env active) and restart MeshCentral:
settings.recordMeshHint: Take Control and the quick support by code, recorded by the MeshCentral server
settings.recordRustdeskHint: Recorded by the computer and sent to this server during the session. Existing computers need Repair / Install remote access to receive the setting
settings.recordQsHint: Recorded by the customer's computer and sent during the session
settings.endpointHint: Empty for Amazon S3. Other providers: e.g. s3.wasabisys.com, s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com
settings.pathStyleHint: Needed by MinIO and some providers
settings.retentionHint: How long recordings are kept is defined by a lifecycle rule of the bucket.
